Use it to characterize the meaning of the text and to track changes across comparable documents or time windows. Its value type is int, which defines whether it should be read as a score, count, label, or structured grouping. Use it to characterize the meaning of the text and to track changes across comparable documents or time windows. Interpretation is strongest when this metric is read together with nearby metrics in the same category rather than in isolation.
